Python with function docstring, verify docstring count

```elixir title="Elixir"

result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("def greet(name):\n    \"\"\"Say hello to someone.\"\"\"\n    return f\"Hello {name}\"\n", config_value)
IO.inspect(result.language)
```
